segments.text:
V. 39.
And going a little farther—About a ſtones caſt: (Luke xxii. 41.) So that the Apoſtles could both ſee and hear him ſtill. If it be poſſible, let this cup paſs from me—And it did paſs from Him quickly. When He cried unto GOD with ſtrong cries and tears, he was heard in that which he feared. GOD did take away the Terror and Severity of that inward Conflict.
